entry_points.summary: Interactive premise refinement — conversational on-ramp that probes, clarifies, reframes, and converges a raw idea into a BRAINSTORM.md variant before routing to /z-brainstorm or /z-plan
Full interactive protocol: Stage 1 (Framing), Stage 2 (Probe/Clarify/Reframe loop with posture spec), Stage 3 (Convergence gate), Stage 4 (Artifact production + route handoff)
Three escape paths: user-initiated abandon, AI-sensed frustration (8+ rounds), disconnect/timeout
Interactive BRAINSTORM.md variant — mode: interactive, ideators: [interactive], single Framing section with Converged premise + Conversation summary

invariants: The user always owns convergence — AI never writes the artifact before user signals convergence
Abandon is clean — no BRAINSTORM.md artifact written on abandon
No subagents, no cross-LLM consult — the conversation IS the refinement
Runs inline in the main thread (pi subagents cannot invoke /z-reality)
Produces a BRAINSTORM.md variant with mode: interactive, ideators: [interactive]
Three logging events only: reality_run_start, reality_convergence, reality_run_end
The artifact has one framing section (no anti-bias check, no ideator blocks)
status: draft is valid — downstream /z-plan treats it as provisional
Slug collision on existing BRAINSTORM.md prompts overwrite/rename/abort choice
Empty $ARGUMENTS opens with 'What are you thinking about?'
User rejecting refinement ('no, just do X') exits immediately
gotchas: Interactive BRAINSTORM.md has mode: interactive — downstream commands must check this field to handle the variant correctly
chosen_framing: interactive is the canonical selection — no user choice step needed in downstream
No phase telemetry — the three session-level events are the only log entries
No claim acquire, no active-plan registration — /z-reality is not a plan-family command
Persona weaving is deferred to v2 — not even a feature flag in v1
Underspecified detection uses two-tier approach: Tier 1 heuristics (free) + Tier 2 planning-router (cheap Haiku)
planning-router rule 5: premise_underspecified routes to /z-reality only if current_command is NOT /z-reality (loop prevention)
